title: blob-server: Blob/convert handler
description:
Design: docs/design/blobext.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: B10. Crates: jmap-blob-server. Size: M.

Implement handle_blob_convert in convert.rs per docs/design/blobext.md §5 'Blob/convert' (blobext-03 §8-§8.8): create required; atomic: true or a non-empty ifUnchangedBy => invalidArguments (Blob/convert is not a Foo/set and ignoring atomic would partly apply an all-or-nothing pipeline; atomic false, {} and null accepted; decision 19); enforce_max_objects_in_set; per-entry parse with zero/several recipe keys -> invalidProperties; check_recipe and check_archive with JSON-pointer property paths (gap h), null capability list -> [<recipeKey>], maxImageDimension/maxArchiveEntries/maxConvertSize -> tooLarge, quality, background, '..' entries, mode; topo_order over all refs with cycle -> every member invalidProperties; resolve refs (notFound); backend convert; ConvertedBlob with isIncomplete/description/entries; Extract returns the archive's id/type/size. Response accountId/created/notCreated only (gap b). Common start incl. BlobMode Conflict. Acceptance: tests/convert.rs covering blobext.md §10 'server, Blob/convert' (§9.4-§9.7 via tar and the stub converter, decision 13), plus Blob/convert with atomic: true or ifUnchangedBy {"x": {}} => invalidArguments and with atomic: false accepted (decision 19), plus deferred-blob tests: Blob/get size materializes, failed deferred -> notFound in get, set and convert.
